definitions: To experience life to its fullest potential, embracing a wide range of activities, relationships, and personal growth.
To have a life rich in experiences, meaning, and satisfaction, often implying a lack of regret for missed opportunities.
examples: She always encouraged her children to travel and explore, so they could live a full life.
After his recovery, he decided to quit his stressful job and truly live a full life.
Many believe that pursuing passions is key to living a full life.
synonyms: suck the marrow out of life
